submitted.rationale: With only 3 merit measurements and no prior data (GP was flat), I sampled the three corners of the composition spread. The Mn-rich one (141, Ca0.14 Co0.23 Mn0.63) gave the highest photocurrent, 2e-8 A. The Co-rich (26) gave 1e-8 A and the Ca-rich (40) gave -2e-8 A. XRD at the Co-rich, Mn-rich and Ca-rich corners showed nearly the same dominant peaks (probably substrate), so it didn't help pick targets.

rejected.reason: Co-rich corner, photocurrent 1e-8 A, lower than 141
Ca-rich corner, photocurrent -2e-8 A (no photoanodic response)
